description: A man in a wide-brimmed hat and dark coat leans forward and thrusts a burning torch into an iron fire basket on a tall wooden post, at the edge of a cliff above a stormy grey sea. Sparks fly and smoke rises into a dark, cloudy sky. On a distant headland to the right, a second small fire burns with a thin plume of smoke. There are no visible letters, frames or borders, and the painting runs edge to edge.
